description: Both coconut oil and lavender need to be added to a body wash. One unit of coconut oil takes 0.7 minutes to be effective while one unit of lavender takes 0.9 minutes to be effective. The body wash must contain at least 300 units of coconut oil and at most 550 units of both ingredients. Since too much coconut oil can make the body wash too oily, there can be at most thrice the amount of coconut oil as lavenders in the body wash. How many units of each should be added to the body wash to minimize the total amount of time it takes for the mixture to be effective? (Note: one must be added before the other)

TimeCoconutOil.definition: Time taken for one unit of coconut oil to be effective

TimeLavender.definition: Time taken for one unit of lavender to be effective

MinCoconutOil.definition: Minimum required units of coconut oil

MaxTotalUnits.definition: Maximum allowed units of both ingredients combined

MaxCoconutToLavenderRatio.definition: Ratio constraint for the maximum units of coconut oil to lavender

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required for the body wash mixture to become effective by choosing the optimal amounts of coconut oil and lavender."

constraints.description: Units of coconut oil added must be at least 300
The total units of coconut oil and lavender combined must not exceed 550
The units of coconut oil must be at most three times the units of lavender

CoconutOilUnits.definition: Units of coconut oil added to the body wash

LavenderUnits.definition: Units of lavender added to the body wash
